text:
Sam W: Quick idea — small console panel: 'Fallback Inspector'. Single-pane summary when an automatic fallback/degrade fires. Show: rule matched, trigger reason, mode (soft-cache / quiet-reject / model-fallback), decision_id, link to trace, and a 'replay (dry-run)' button. Keep it lightweight.

Maya R: +1. We need stable telemetry key names first though. Can't build UI that links to ephemeral fields. :thumbsup:

Oliver K: Visibility is great, but we must not store full request payloads by default. Inspector should show sampled_request_id and trace_id; expanding to full payload requires tenant opt-in and auditor RBAC.

Carla L: UX should include a micro-timeline at the top: decision_time_ms, observed_latency_tail, pre-route -> post-route. Also breadcrumbs for rule eval order (so you can spot oscillation).

infra-bot: Deploy note: autofallback-inspector-v1 enabled in eng-platform/staging for 5% of traffic.

Nikhil P: Proposed decision API envelope (summary-focused):

```
{
  "decision_id": "uuid",
  "timestamp": "iso",
  "trigger": "500_spike|latency_tail|quota_exceeded|manual_override",
  "rule_id": "string",
  "mode": "soft_cache|quiet_reject|model_fallback",
  "pre_route": "route-name@v1",
  "post_route": "route-name@v0-quant",
  "trace_id": "trace-xxx",
  "sampled_request_id": "short-id",
  "audit_link": "https://.../audit/decision_id"
}
```

Maya R: Add estimated_cost_delta and optional regression_score (if eval telemetry exists) so product teams can quickly see impact.

Carla L: UI should hide cost/quality by default; show a small badge: ⚠ quality-risk 7% next to decision. Expand for details.

OpsOnCall: If fallback was due to dedicated-cluster quota, Inspector must show quota bucket, usage, and remaining tokens. Otherwise SRE gets paged blind.

Sam W: Good point. Also plan a hover 'why' badge in routes list: shows a short summary (last 24h samples) and links to Inspector. Keep it cheap — summary only.

Oliver K: Retention proposal: full decision envelopes 30 days, metadata counters for 365 days. RBAC so only users with role "auditor" can expand to payload. That addresses compliance.

Nikhil P: Standard telemetry keys: fallback.trigger, fallback.rule_id, fallback.mode, fallback.decision_id, fallback.cost_delta. Makes dashboards and alerts straightforward.

Maya R: We want a dry-run toggle (UI + API) that simulates routing without altering production routing: button labelled "Preview fallback (dry-run)".

Carla L: Replay flow: Inspector's replay calls orchestration API with dry_run=true and attaches original trace_id. Use signed short-lived token so replay is auditable.

OpsOnCall: Ops asks: 1) show counts of auto-fallbacks in last 5m/1h; 2) allow operator-level mute of noisy fallback rules directly from Inspector (with an undo).

Sam W: Implementation sketch: frontend Inspector + mini timeline (Carla), decision-api endpoint (Nikhil), telemetry naming + retention (Oliver), dry-run/replay wiring (Maya), ops controls (OpsOnCall).

infra-bot: Note: this requires a small schema migration for decision events. Create migration ticket before enabling rollout toggle.

Nikhil P: API detail: add explain(decision_id, level=summary|full). Console fetches summary for lists; expands to full only on demand. Keeps list queries cheap.

Maya R: Summary payload should be ~200 bytes. Full includes pointers to traces and audit payloads, not full inline text unless permitted.

Carla L: I'll sketch mocks tomorrow and attach to the GH issue. Can we ship a small example summary response for the design doc?

Sam W: I'll open the GH issue and assign owners: frontend (Carla), decision-api (Nikhil), telemetry+retention (Oliver), dry-run hook (Maya), ops controls (OpsOnCall). ETA: prototype in ~2 weeks assuming infra capacity. :rocket:

OpsOnCall: Safety: limit replay per decision_id to 5/min and global replay rate to 100/min. Also log replay actor and IP.

Oliver K: Add tenant-level redact flag defaulting to redacted. Only when tenant opts-in or has auditor role do we surface request_text.

Sam W: Will include replay limits, RBAC, retention and redact defaults in the GH issue. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
